# Voice & Publish Editor Insight

Thor's current edits and explicit feedback are the strongest voice evidence for an editorial pass. Preserve deliberate deletions, especially removed anecdotes, hooks, transition slogans, and conclusions. When a deleted line exposes a weak transition, tighten the surrounding prose or let the next heading carry the move instead of writing a replacement slogan.

Technical workflow articles read more like Thor when they start with his action, explain each role through what a reader can see, and introduce repository terms only when they add useful precision. Check soft openings, repeated words, repeated role names, and repeated ownership claims. A reader who skips the code blocks and visuals should still understand what Thor asks for, what Copilot does, how the browser checks the work, and which decisions remain his.
